name: india-voice-platform
description: Multi-tenant India voice platform â€” Phase 1 foundation

scripts.build: npm run build -w @india-voice/database && npm run build -w @india-voice/api && npm run build -w @india-voice/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @india-voice/database && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @india-voice/database && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @india-voice/api" "npm run dev -w @india-voice/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @india-voice/database && npm run dev -w @india-voice/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @india-voice/database && npm run test -w @india-voice/database && npm run test -w @india-voice/api
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:database && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:voice
scripts.dev:platform: npm run infra:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run build -w @india-voice/database && concurrently -k -n api,web,voice "npm run dev -w @india-voice/api" "npm run dev -w @india-voice/web" "npm run dev:voice"
